name: Single Responsive Image Formatter
description: Provides responsive formatter for images that displays only first value of multi-valued image field
project_description:
This module provides formatters for Image , Media and Responsive image field, that displays only first value of multi-valued fields. It is useful, when you configure teasers display and don't need to show all images. 

 How to use? 
 Just install this module as usual, enable it and choose "Single image formatter", "Single media thumbnail" or "Single responsive image" option in "Manage display" tab of your entity.

 Single media thumbnail and Single responsive image are contained in submodules. You should enable appropriate submodule to use them.
